## Milestone 1 - Task 2: Excel Ingestion

Reads a test script from `test-scripts/samples/`, drops empty rows, and normalizes each remaining row into the shared Test Case JSON schema (docs/architecture/milestone-1.md, section 7).

Each normalized object is handed to the **Planner** node - this workflow does not call the Planner's logic itself. API Agent, Decision Agent, Documentation Agent and Jira Agent are out of scope for this task.

nodes.name: Planner
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary to the Planner Agent. Planner routing logic is not part of Task 2 (Excel Ingestion) and is built in a later task.
